# Vijetha Digital — Full Reference

> Vijetha Digital is a commercial printing and signage company based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, established in 2009. The company manufactures and supplies LED sign boards, ACP cladding signs, acrylic letter signs, vehicle branding, flex and vinyl printing, offset printing, UV printing, screen printing, exhibition displays, trade show booths, indoor office branding, and outdoor advertising materials. Vijetha Digital serves 1,000+ businesses across South India including Fortune 500 companies, retail chains, banks, and government bodies.

## Production Equipment

- HP Latex 570 — large format water-based latex printing, up to 64 inches wide
- Epson Surecolor S80670 — eco-solvent large format, 1440 dpi
- Roland Soljet EJ 640 — eco-solvent printing for outdoor durability
- K Tech 1325 HD CNC Router — precision acrylic and aluminium cutting
- LED fabrication line — custom LED module assembly and sign board manufacturing
- Screen printing press — bulk screen printing for textiles and substrates
- UV flatbed printer — direct UV printing on rigid substrates

## Service Categories & Products

### Signage Solutions
1. **LED Sign Board** — Aluminium frame, acrylic face, LED modules. IP65 weatherproof. 3,000–5,000 lumens/sq.ft. From Rs 3,500.
2. **ACP Cladding Sign** — 4mm Goldplus ACP sheets, 3D letter fabrication. Glossy, matte, brushed, mirror finishes. From Rs 2,200.
3. **Acrylic Letter Sign** — CNC-cut 5–25mm acrylic. Backlit, front-lit, or non-lit. 500+ colour options. From Rs 1,800.
4. **Fascia Sign Board** — Full-width storefront signs. Flex-lit, ACP, LED backlit, acrylic variants. From Rs 4,500.
5. **Flex Board Hoarding** — HP Latex 570, 440 GSM frontlit flex. 1 lakh sq.ft/day capacity. From Rs 18/sq.ft.
6. **Pylon Sign** — MS/SS fabrication, 8–40ft height. LED or floodlit. Structural drawings coordinated. From Rs 8,000.

### Internal Branding
7. **Office Wall Branding** — Vinyl wall graphics, UV prints, canvas murals, 3D lettering for corporate offices.
8. **Reception & Lobby** — Backlit logo panels, feature walls, wayfinding elements.
9. **Retail In-Shop Branding** — Multi-location rollouts for Samsung, Reliance Digital, Airtel, Vivo stores.
10. **Hospital Branding** — Wayfinding systems, department signage, fire-retardant materials.

### Vehicle Branding
11. **Car / 4-Wheeler Wrap** — 3M vinyl or Avery Dennison cast vinyl. Full/partial wraps. 5–7 year durability. From Rs 3,500.
12. **Bus / Van Branding** — Full body wraps, perforated window vinyl. Fleet pricing for 5+ vehicles. From Rs 6,000.
13. **2-Wheeler Branding** — Delivery bike decals, half/full wraps. Same-day standard designs. From Rs 800.
14. **Heavy Vehicle Branding** — Trucks, lorries, containers. High-tack commercial vehicle vinyl. On request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the minimum order for flex printing?**
A: No minimum for standard sizes. Same-day production for orders under 500 sq.ft submitted before 12 PM.

**Q: Do you provide installation services in Hyderabad?**
A: Yes. Vijetha Digital provides professional installation for all signage across Hyderabad, Secunderabad, and surrounding areas.

**Q: How long does an LED sign board last?**
A: 5–10 years with proper maintenance. LED modules carry a 2-year warranty. IP65-rated for weatherproof outdoor use.

**Q: Can vehicle wraps be removed without damaging paint?**
A: Yes. Premium 3M and Avery Dennison cast vinyl removes cleanly without paint damage for up to 7 years after application.

**Q: Do you handle multi-city branding rollouts?**
A: Yes. Vijetha Digital has executed pan-India rollouts for Samsung, Reliance Digital, Airtel, and Jio with design templates, production batching, logistics, and installation coordination.

**Q: What is the fastest turnaround available?**
A: Same-day for flex banners and standees under 500 sq.ft (submit artwork before 12 PM). Vehicle wraps in 1–2 days. LED signs in 5–7 working days.

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: WhatsApp +91 92481 95552 with product type, dimensions, and quantity. Response within 1–2 hours. Free site visit available for large signage projects.
